description: Send Swell orders, payments and subscriptions to PostHog.
name: PostHog

images.title: Every order, in PostHog
images.description: Orders, payments and subscriptions arrive in PostHog as server-side events, tied to the customer's account with their name and email.

images.title: Revenue you can trust
images.description: Every charge is counted once, whether it pays for an order or a subscription. Refunds subtract revenue, partial ones too.

images.title: Subscriptions, start to churn
images.description: Starts, renewals, failed payments and cancellations land on every customer's timeline.

images.title: Set up in a minute
images.description: Paste your PostHog project key, pick US, EU or your own host, send a test event and choose which events to send.
